item.title: SJVN Discovers Tariff Of Rs 1.97 Lakh/MW/Month For Its 2-Hour 250 MW/500 MWh Standalone BESS Tender
item.description: SJVN recently awarded a tender for its 250 MW/500 MWh standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) in Panipat, Haryana, at a tariff of Rs 1.97 lakh/MW/month. The tender was awarded to Hardi Hydro Energy Private Limited, two months after SJVN issued it in December 2025. The latest tender brought down the BESS tariff from previous peaks, as seen in GUVNL’s 335 MW/670 MWh 2-hour cycle BESS tender under the VGF scheme, which had tariffs ranging from Rs 2.10 lakh/MW/month to Rs 2.12 lakh/MW/month.

item.title: Inox Wind Hits New High In Q3 Fy26 Revenues, PAT Up 14%
item.description: Inox Wind Limited (IWL), announced its financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 on Feb 13. Q3 Fy26 was IWL's best-ever performance, posting revenues of Rs 1,238 crores, up 24% YoY, and EBITDA of Rs 313 crores, up 39% YoY. EBITDA margins came in at 25.2%. Profit before tax for the quarter was up 62% YoY to Rs 209 cr, while PAT was up 14% YoY at Rs 127 cr, despite a deferred tax charge of Rs 83 cr during the quarter (a non-cash accounting adjustment). Cash PAT increased by 38% YoY
